metadata.notes: Manual Copilot generation for stage-3 records; protected source fields were kept unchanged.

word_meaning.meaning_en: the whole amount, number, or every part
word_meaning.meaning_zh: ad.全部地a.全（部）;所有的;总;整pron.全部;全体人员

word_example.example_en: All the windows were open this morning.
word_example.example_zh: 今天早上所有窗户都开着。

word_example.example_en: They all smiled after hearing the news.
word_example.example_zh: 他们听到消息后都笑了。

word_meaning.meaning_en: made ill by something, or strongly disliking it

word_example.example_en: She is allergic to cats and dust.
word_example.example_zh: 她对猫和灰尘过敏。

word_example.example_en: He seems allergic to boring office talk.
word_example.example_zh: 他似乎很厌烦无聊的办公室谈话。

word_meaning.meaning_en: a narrow passage or street between buildings

word_example.example_en: A dog barked loudly in the alley.
word_example.example_zh: 一只狗在小巷里大声叫。

word_example.example_en: We found a cafe beside the alley.
word_example.example_zh: 我们在小巷旁找到一家咖啡馆。

word_meaning.meaning_en: to give something for a special purpose

word_example.example_en: The team will allocate money for books.
word_example.example_zh: 团队将为书籍分配资金。

word_example.example_en: We should allocate time for daily review.
word_example.example_zh: 我们应该分配时间进行每日复习。

word_meaning.meaning_en: to let someone do something or permit it

word_example.example_en: Our coach allows water breaks in summer.
word_example.example_zh: 我们的教练在夏天允许喝水休息。

word_example.example_en: The rules do not allow late entry.
word_example.example_zh: 这些规则不允许迟到入场。

word_meaning.meaning_en: money given regularly or an amount allowed

word_example.example_en: He saved half his weekly allowance carefully.
word_example.example_zh: 他认真存下了一半的周零花钱。

word_example.example_en: Travel allowance covered meals and train tickets.
word_example.example_zh: 差旅补助支付了餐费和火车票。

word_meaning.meaning_en: nearly but not completely

word_example.example_en: I almost forgot my keys this morning.
word_example.example_zh: 今天早上我差点忘了带钥匙。

word_example.example_en: The lake was almost frozen at dawn.
word_example.example_zh: 黎明时湖面几乎结冰了。

word_meaning.meaning_en: without other people; by yourself

word_example.example_en: She lives alone in a small apartment.
word_example.example_zh: 她独自住在一个小公寓里。

word_example.example_en: You are not alone in this fight.
word_example.example_zh: 在这场奋斗中你并不孤单。

word_meaning.meaning_en: forward or beside something; following a line
word_meaning.meaning_zh: ad.向前；和…一起；一同prep.沿着；顺着

word_example.example_en: We walked along the beach after lunch.
word_example.example_zh: 午饭后我们沿着海滩散步。

word_example.example_en: Bring your cousin along to the show.
word_example.example_zh: 带你表弟一起去看演出吧。

word_meaning.meaning_en: next to something or together with it

word_example.example_en: A boat moved alongside the wooden bridge.
word_example.example_zh: 一条船沿着木桥旁边驶过。

word_example.example_en: Technology grew alongside modern medical progress.
word_example.example_zh: 科技随着现代医学进步而发展。

word_meaning.meaning_en: in a voice that can be heard

word_example.example_en: Please read the paragraph aloud for us.
word_example.example_zh: 请把这段文字大声读给我们听。

word_example.example_en: He laughed aloud at the silly joke.
word_example.example_zh: 他听到那个傻笑话后大声笑了。

word_meaning.meaning_en: the set of letters used in writing

word_example.example_en: Children practiced the alphabet with song cards.
word_example.example_zh: 孩子们用歌曲卡片练习字母表。

word_example.example_en: This language uses a different alphabet system.
word_example.example_zh: 这种语言使用不同的字母系统。

word_meaning.meaning_en: before now or earlier than expected

word_example.example_en: She has already mailed the final report.
word_example.example_zh: 她已经寄出了最终报告。

word_example.example_en: The train had already left the station.
word_example.example_zh: 火车已经离开了车站。

word_meaning.meaning_en: in addition; too

word_example.example_en: She sings well and also paints nicely.
word_example.example_zh: 她唱歌好，也画画得很好。

word_example.example_en: The room is small but also warm.
word_example.example_zh: 这个房间很小，但也很温暖。

word_meaning.meaning_en: another choice or a different way of doing something

word_example.example_en: We need an alternative plan for rain.
word_example.example_zh: 我们需要一个应对下雨的备用方案。

word_example.example_en: Solar power offers an alternative energy source.
word_example.example_zh: 太阳能提供了一种替代能源。

word_meaning.meaning_en: despite the fact that; even though

word_example.example_en: Although tired, she finished the whole report.
word_example.example_zh: 虽然很累，她还是完成了整份报告。

word_example.example_en: Although it rained, the game continued.
word_example.example_zh: 虽然下雨了，比赛还是继续了。

word_meaning.meaning_en: height above sea level or above the ground

word_example.example_en: The village lies at high altitude year-round.
word_example.example_zh: 这个村庄常年处于高海拔地区。

word_example.example_en: Pilots checked altitude before crossing the mountains.
word_example.example_zh: 飞行员在越过群山前检查了高度。

word_meaning.meaning_en: in total or completely

word_example.example_en: There were twenty students altogether in class.
word_example.example_zh: 班里总共有二十名学生。

word_example.example_en: I stopped using that phone altogether yesterday.
word_example.example_zh: 我昨天彻底停止用那部手机了。

word_meaning.meaning_en: a light silver metal used in many products

word_example.example_en: The ladder is made of light aluminium.
word_example.example_zh: 这把梯子由轻质铝制成。

word_example.example_en: Aluminium cans are easy to recycle.
word_example.example_zh: 铝罐很容易回收利用。

word_meaning.meaning_en: at all times or on every occasion

word_example.example_en: She always arrives early for morning class.
word_example.example_zh: 她总是很早到晨课。

word_example.example_en: Kind words always make people feel better.
word_example.example_zh: 善意的话总能让人感觉更好。

word_meaning.meaning_en: the first person singular present form of be

word_example.example_en: I am ready for the science quiz.
word_example.example_zh: 我准备好参加科学小测了。

word_example.example_en: I am happy to help you today.
word_example.example_zh: 我很高兴今天帮助你。

word_meaning.meaning_en: the time before noon; in the morning

word_example.example_en: The train leaves at nine a.m. sharp.
word_example.example_zh: 火车上午九点整出发。

word_example.example_en: Our first class starts at eight a.m.
word_example.example_zh: 我们的第一节课上午八点开始。

word_meaning.meaning_en: used to show that a time is before noon

word_example.example_en: Please arrive before 10 A.M. tomorrow.
word_example.example_zh: 请明天上午十点前到达。

word_example.example_en: The clinic opens at 8 A.M. daily.
word_example.example_zh: 诊所每天上午八点开门。

word_meaning.meaning_en: a notation showing the time before noon

word_example.example_en: Write a.m. or A.M. after the time.
word_example.example_zh: 请在时间后面写上 a.m. 或 A.M.。

word_example.example_en: The exam starts at 7 a.m. today.
word_example.example_zh: 今天考试在上午七点开始。

word_meaning.meaning_en: done for pleasure rather than as a job; a non-professional person

word_example.example_en: He is an amateur painter after work.
word_example.example_zh: 他下班后是一名业余画家。

word_example.example_en: This amateur team trained every weekend together.
word_example.example_zh: 这支业余队伍每周末一起训练。

word_meaning.meaning_en: to surprise someone very much

word_example.example_en: Her calm answer did amaze the judges.
word_example.example_zh: 她冷静的回答确实让评委惊讶。

word_example.example_en: The night sky can amaze young children.
word_example.example_zh: 夜空会让小孩子感到惊叹。

word_meaning.meaning_en: very surprising and impressive

word_example.example_en: The robot gave an amazing dance performance.
word_example.example_zh: 那个机器人带来了惊人的舞蹈表演。

word_example.example_en: We saw amazing colors above the lake.
word_example.example_zh: 我们看到湖面上方惊人的色彩。

word_meaning.meaning_en: the highest official sent to represent a country abroad

word_example.example_en: The ambassador visited our city last week.
word_example.example_zh: 那位大使上周访问了我们城市。

word_example.example_en: An ambassador represents national interests abroad.
word_example.example_zh: 大使在国外代表国家利益。

word_meaning.meaning_en: a female ambassador or the wife of an ambassador

word_example.example_en: The ambassadress attended the cultural dinner yesterday.
word_example.example_zh: 那位女大使昨天出席了文化晚宴。

word_example.example_en: The report mentioned an ambassadress by name.
word_example.example_zh: 那篇报道提到了一位女大使的名字。

word_meaning.meaning_en: having more than one meaning and not clear

word_example.example_en: His ambiguous reply confused the whole class.
word_example.example_zh: 他模棱两可的回答让全班困惑。

word_example.example_en: The sign looked ambiguous in poor light.
word_example.example_zh: 那块标志在昏暗光线下看起来含糊不清。

word_meaning.meaning_en: a strong wish to achieve something important

word_example.example_en: Her ambition is to become a doctor.
word_example.example_zh: 她的抱负是成为一名医生。

word_example.example_en: Strong ambition pushed him through hard years.
word_example.example_zh: 强烈的雄心推动他度过艰难岁月。

word_meaning.meaning_en: a vehicle used to take sick or injured people to hospital

word_example.example_en: The ambulance arrived within ten minutes yesterday.
word_example.example_zh: 昨天救护车十分钟内就到了。

word_example.example_en: We heard the ambulance near the school.
word_example.example_zh: 我们在学校附近听到了救护车。

word_meaning.meaning_en: the United States, or the Americas in some contexts

word_example.example_en: America attracts many travelers every summer.
word_example.example_zh: 美国每年夏天吸引许多旅行者。

word_example.example_en: She hopes to study in America someday.
word_example.example_zh: 她希望有一天去美国学习。

word_meaning.meaning_en: from the United States; a person from the United States
word_meaning.meaning_zh: a.美国的；美国人的n.美国人

word_example.example_en: American films are popular with many teens.
word_example.example_zh: 美国电影很受许多青少年欢迎。

word_example.example_en: An American teacher visited our class yesterday.
word_example.example_zh: 一位美国老师昨天来访问了我们班。

word_meaning.meaning_en: in the middle of or included in a group
word_meaning.meaning_zh: prep.在…中间；在（三个以上）之间

word_example.example_en: She sat among friends during the concert.
word_example.example_zh: 音乐会期间她坐在朋友们中间。

word_example.example_en: Trust grows among people who work together.
word_example.example_zh: 在一起工作的人之间会建立信任。

word_meaning.meaning_en: a quantity of something; to add up to a total

word_example.example_en: The amount of rain surprised local farmers.
word_example.example_zh: 降雨量让当地农民感到惊讶。

word_example.example_en: The costs amount to nearly one thousand.
word_example.example_zh: 这些费用总计接近一千。

word_meaning.meaning_en: enough or more than enough

word_example.example_en: We have ample time before the exam.
word_example.example_zh: 考试前我们有充足的时间。

word_example.example_en: The hall offers ample space for dancing.
word_example.example_zh: 这个大厅有足够的跳舞空间。

word_meaning.meaning_en: to make someone laugh or feel entertained

word_example.example_en: Funny stories amuse children during long trips.
word_example.example_zh: 有趣的故事会在长途旅行中逗乐孩子。

word_example.example_en: His small tricks always amuse the audience.
word_example.example_zh: 他的小把戏总能逗乐观众。

word_meaning.meaning_en: the feeling of being entertained or something that gives fun

word_example.example_en: The park offers amusement for every age.
word_example.example_zh: 这个公园为各年龄段提供娱乐。

word_example.example_en: To our amusement, the cat opened doors.
word_example.example_zh: 让我们觉得有趣的是，那只猫会开门。

word_meaning.meaning_en: to study something carefully and in detail

word_example.example_en: Scientists analyze data before drawing conclusions.
word_example.example_zh: 科学家在得出结论前会分析数据。

word_example.example_en: We must analyze the poem line by line.
word_example.example_zh: 我们必须逐行分析这首诗。

word_meaning.meaning_en: a careful study of something or the result of that study

word_example.example_en: Her analysis of the chart was clear.
word_example.example_zh: 她对图表的分析很清晰。

word_example.example_en: The final analysis supported our original idea.
word_example.example_zh: 最终分析支持了我们最初的想法。

word_meaning.meaning_en: a person related to you who lived long ago

word_example.example_en: My ancestor farmed this land centuries ago.
word_example.example_zh: 我的祖先几个世纪前在这片土地上耕作。

word_example.example_en: The story honors one brave family ancestor.
word_example.example_zh: 这个故事纪念了一位勇敢的家族祖先。

word_meaning.meaning_en: a heavy object that keeps a ship in place

word_example.example_en: The captain dropped the anchor near shore.
word_example.example_zh: 船长在岸边附近抛下了锚。

word_example.example_en: A strong anchor kept the boat steady.
word_example.example_zh: 一只坚固的锚让小船保持稳定。

word_meaning.meaning_en: very old and from a long time ago

word_example.example_en: They visited an ancient temple near town.
word_example.example_zh: 他们参观了城镇附近的一座古庙。

word_example.example_en: Ancient stories still inspire modern readers today.
word_example.example_zh: 古代故事今天仍激励现代读者。

word_meaning.meaning_en: used to join words, phrases, or sentences

word_example.example_en: Tom and Lily cleaned the room together.
word_example.example_zh: 汤姆和莉莉一起打扫了房间。

word_example.example_en: She opened the window and smiled softly.
word_example.example_zh: 她打开窗户，轻轻笑了。

word_meaning.meaning_en: a short, interesting story about a real event

word_example.example_en: The teacher shared an anecdote before class.
word_example.example_zh: 老师上课前分享了一则趣闻。

word_example.example_en: His travel anecdotes amused us all night.
word_example.example_zh: 他的旅行趣闻逗乐了我们一整晚。

word_meaning.meaning_en: a strong feeling of being upset or mad

word_example.example_en: His anger grew during the long meeting.
word_example.example_zh: 在漫长的会议中，他的愤怒越来越强。

word_example.example_en: Careless lies can anger close friends.
word_example.example_zh: 粗心的谎言会激怒亲密朋友。

word_meaning.meaning_en: the space between two lines or surfaces

word_example.example_en: Measure the angle with this plastic ruler.
word_example.example_zh: 用这把塑料尺测量这个角度。

word_example.example_en: The camera caught the building from one angle.
word_example.example_zh: 相机从一个角度拍下了这栋建筑。

word_meaning.meaning_en: feeling strong dislike because something is wrong

word_example.example_en: She felt angry after hearing the lie.
word_example.example_zh: 听到那个谎言后她很生气。

word_example.example_en: The angry crowd waited outside the gate.
word_example.example_zh: 愤怒的人群在门外等待。

word_meaning.meaning_en: a living creature that is not a plant or person

word_example.example_en: Every animal needs water, food, and shelter.
word_example.example_zh: 每种动物都需要水、食物和栖身处。

word_example.example_en: The zoo protects each animal very carefully.
word_example.example_zh: 动物园非常认真地保护每只动物。
